cd /workspace/tmp/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import ipaddress, json, time, sys, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ipv6_replay', '/workspace/submission/ipv6_replay.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

data = open('t/heavy2.jsonl','rb').read()
rows = data.split(b'\n')
rows.pop()
print('rows', len(rows))

# 1. decode utf-8
t0=time.perf_counter()
texts = [r.decode('utf-8') for r in rows]
print('decode utf-8   : %.2fs' % (time.perf_counter()-t0))

# 2. strict json parse
t0=time.perf_counter()
objs = [m.decode_json_strict(t) for t in texts]
print('strict json     : %.2fs' % (time.perf_counter()-t0))

# 2b. plain json parse
t0=time.perf_counter()
objs2 = [json.loads(t) for t in texts]
print('plain json      : %.2fs' % (time.perf_counter()-t0))

# 3. address parse
t0=time.perf_counter()
vals = [m.parse_address(o['source']) for o in objs]
print('parse_address   : %.2fs' % (time.perf_counter()-t0))

# 3b. raw ipaddress
t0=time.perf_counter()
vals2 = [int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(o['source'])) for o in objs]
print('IPv6Address()   : %.2fs' % (time.perf_counter()-t0))

# 4. format address
t0=time.perf_counter()
strs = [str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v)) for v in vals]
print('format_address  : %.2fs' % (time.perf_counter()-t0))

# 4b. private string_from_ip_int
t0=time.perf_counter()
strs2 = [ipaddress.IPv6Address._string_from_ip_int(v) for v in vals]
print('priv _string    : %.2fs' % (time.perf_counter()-t0))
assert strs == strs2

# 5. schema check
t0=time.perf_counter()
rs = [m._row_schema_reason(o) for o in objs]
print('schema check    : %.2fs' % (time.perf_counter()-t0))
EOF
